logistic_regularized.status: EXPLORATORY; descriptive values only, no performance claim
logistic_regularized.handling: Single-class draws leave AP undefined. Recall is undefined without actual positives; precision is undefined without predicted positives. Brier remains defined. No forced-zero AP, no resampling until positives appear. Intervals with >5% undefined draws are not published.
logistic_regularized.average_precision_definition: Account-weighted, non-interpolated average precision; not trapezoidal PR area or a mean over mostly single-class accounts.
